title: Why bundlers exist

blocks.md:
## The browser has no `require` of your files

A page can load one script URL (or native ESM URLs you list). `require("./walker.js")` is a Node idea. The browser does not walk a folder of files the way Node does.

A **bundler** follows your `import` graph and emits files the browser can load. This lesson does not run a bundler. It asks you to name the gap.

The fox walker lives in `walker.mjs`. On the desk, Node can `import` it. A plain page cannot `require` that folder unless you bundle or ship real ESM URLs.
